## EDA 1: Target Structure and Key Patterns {.smaller}

```{r eda-slide-1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=13.8, fig.height=5.0, out.width="100%"}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

df <- read_csv("survey_results_public.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

convert_years <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x == "Less than 1 year"] <- "0.5"
  x[x == "More than 50 years"] <- "51"
  as.numeric(x)
}

eda_df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    JobSat = as.numeric(JobSat),
    JobSat_5 = case_when(
      JobSat <= 1  ~ "Very Dissatisfied",
      JobSat <= 3  ~ "Dissatisfied",
      JobSat <= 6  ~ "Neutral",
      JobSat <= 8  ~ "Satisfied",
      JobSat <= 10 ~ "Very Satisfied",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    JobSat_3 = case_when(
      JobSat <= 3  ~ "Negative",
      JobSat <= 6  ~ "Neutral",
      JobSat <= 10 ~ "Positive",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    JobSat_5 = factor(
      JobSat_5,
      levels = c("Very Dissatisfied", "Dissatisfied", "Neutral", "Satisfied", "Very Satisfied")
    ),
    JobSat_3 = factor(
      JobSat_3,
      levels = c("Negative", "Neutral", "Positive")
    ),
    WorkExp = as.numeric(WorkExp),
    YearsCode = convert_years(YearsCode),
    ConvertedCompYearly = as.numeric(ConvertedCompYearly),
    LogSalary = log1p(ConvertedCompYearly)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(JobSat_3), !is.na(JobSat_5))

# ============================================================
# Target distributions
# ============================================================

target_5 <- eda_df %>%
  count(JobSat_5) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    Class = as.character(JobSat_5)
  )

target_3 <- eda_df %>%
  count(JobSat_3) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    Class = as.character(JobSat_3)
  )

target_colours <- c(
  "Very Dissatisfied" = "#D95F5F",
  "Dissatisfied" = "#F28E8E",
  "Neutral" = "#E9B45B",
  "Satisfied" = "#9EC9F3",
  "Very Satisfied" = "#5F9ED1",
  "Negative" = "#EB6A6A",
  "Positive" = "#8FBCEB"
)

p_target_5 <- ggplot(target_5, aes(x = prop, y = fct_rev(JobSat_5), fill = Class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(n, "  (", percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), ")")),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 0.58)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = target_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "Five-class target",
    x = "Share of valid JobSat responses",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5, margin = margin(b = 1)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.8),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 3, 1, 3)
  )

p_target_3 <- ggplot(target_3, aes(x = prop, y = fct_rev(JobSat_3), fill = Class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(n, "  (", percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), ")")),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 0.82)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = target_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "Three-class target",
    x = "Share of valid JobSat responses",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.5, margin = margin(b = 1)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 3, 1, 3)
  )

p_target <- (p_target_5 | p_target_3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Target distribution comparison",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12.5, margin = margin(b = 2))
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Missingness
# ============================================================

missing_vars <- c(
  "JobSat", "ConvertedCompYearly", "WorkExp", "YearsCode",
  "OrgSize", "RemoteWork", "AISelect", "AISent", "AIThreat", "DevType"
)

missing_df <- df %>%
  select(any_of(missing_vars)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "MissingRate") %>%
  arrange(desc(MissingRate)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 7)

p_missing <- ggplot(missing_df, aes(x = MissingRate, y = reorder(Variable, MissingRate))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E15759", width = 0.62) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(MissingRate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 2.8,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 0.58)) +
  labs(
    title = "Missingness in important fields",
    x = "Missing rate",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12.5, margin = margin(b = 1)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 1, 4)
  )

# ============================================================
# Salary and work experience by target class
# ============================================================

plot_data <- eda_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(WorkExp), !is.na(LogSalary), is.finite(LogSalary)) %>%
  mutate(
    WorkExp = pmin(WorkExp, quantile(WorkExp, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
    LogSalary = pmin(LogSalary, quantile(LogSalary, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

p_salary <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = JobSat_3, y = LogSalary, fill = JobSat_3)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.05, width = 0.56, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#F4A3A3", "Neutral" = "#F2D28B", "Positive" = "#BFDDF5")) +
  labs(
    title = "Salary overlaps across groups",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log yearly compensation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 1)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 1, 4)
  )

p_work <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = JobSat_3, y = WorkExp, fill = JobSat_3)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.05, width = 0.56, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#F4A3A3", "Neutral" = "#F2D28B", "Positive" = "#BFDDF5")) +
  labs(
    title = "Experience overlaps across groups",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Years of work experience"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 1)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 1, 4)
  )

top_panel <- p_target | p_missing
bottom_panel <- p_salary | p_work

(top_panel / bottom_panel) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.02, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    subtitle = "We checked both five-class and three-class targets. Three-class is simpler and clearer.",
    caption = "Meaning: the target is imbalanced. Salary and experience overlap across groups, so accuracy alone is not enough.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11.5, color = "grey25", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9.6, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 7))
    )
  )
```

## EDA 2: Feature Relationships and Class Separability {.smaller}

```{r eda-slide-2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=13.8, fig.height=5.0, out.width="100%"}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# ============================================================
# Remote work pattern
# ============================================================

remote_df <- eda_df %>%
  mutate(
    RemoteGroup = case_when(
      str_detect(RemoteWork, regex("remote", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
        str_detect(RemoteWork, regex("in-person", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Hybrid",
      str_detect(RemoteWork, regex("remote", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Remote",
      str_detect(RemoteWork, regex("person", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "In-person",
      is.na(RemoteWork) ~ "Missing",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    RemoteGroup = factor(RemoteGroup, levels = c("In-person", "Hybrid", "Remote", "Other", "Missing"))
  ) %>%
  count(JobSat_3, RemoteGroup) %>%
  group_by(JobSat_3) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_remote <- ggplot(remote_df, aes(x = JobSat_3, y = prop, fill = RemoteGroup)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.62) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "In-person" = "#00A878",
    "Hybrid" = "#9A9E00",
    "Remote" = "#1BA3D8",
    "Other" = "#D65FDD",
    "Missing" = "#BDBDBD"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Remote work patterns overlap",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Within-class proportion",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.2) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10.8, margin = margin(b = 1)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6.4),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 1, 4)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

# ============================================================
# Correlation heatmap
# ============================================================

corr_df <- eda_df %>%
  transmute(
    WorkExp,
    YearsCode,
    ToolWork = as.numeric(ToolCountWork),
    ToolPersonal = as.numeric(ToolCountPersonal),
    LogSalary
  )

corr_mat <- cor(corr_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
corr_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(corr_mat))
names(corr_long) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")

p_corr <- ggplot(corr_long, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#4575B4",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#D73027",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Numeric features are related",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Corr."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.2) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10.8, margin = margin(b = 1)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6.4),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 1, 4)
  )

# ============================================================
# PCA
# ============================================================

cap_numeric <- function(x, lower_prob = 0.01, upper_prob = 0.99) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  lower <- quantile(x, lower_prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  upper <- quantile(x, upper_prob, na.rm = TRUE)
  x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & x < lower, lower, x)
  x <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & x > upper, upper, x)
  med <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(med)) med <- 0
  x[is.na(x)] <- med
  x
}

clean_factor <- function(x, top_n = 5) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "Missing"
  top_levels <- names(sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(top_n, length(unique(x)))]
  x[!(x %in% top_levels)] <- "Other"
  factor(x)
}

pca_df <- eda_df %>%
  transmute(
    JobSat_3,
    WorkExp,
    YearsCode,
    ToolCountWork,
    ToolCountPersonal,
    LogSalary,
    Age,
    EdLevel,
    RemoteWork,
    OrgSize,
    ICorPM,
    AISent,
    AIAcc,
    AIThreat,
    NewRole,
    PurchaseInfluence
  )

numeric_vars <- c("WorkExp", "YearsCode", "ToolCountWork", "ToolCountPersonal", "LogSalary")
categorical_vars <- setdiff(names(pca_df), c("JobSat_3", numeric_vars))

for (v in numeric_vars) {
  pca_df[[v]] <- cap_numeric(pca_df[[v]], 0.01, 0.99)
}

for (v in categorical_vars) {
  pca_df[[v]] <- clean_factor(pca_df[[v]], top_n = 5)
}

x_mat <- model.matrix(~ . - JobSat_3 - 1, data = pca_df)
keep_cols <- apply(x_mat, 2, sd) > 0
x_mat <- x_mat[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
x_mat <- scale(x_mat)

pca_fit <- prcomp(x_mat, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
var_exp <- round(100 * summary(pca_fit)$importance[2, 1:2], 1)

pca_plot_df <- tibble(
  PC1 = pca_fit$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_fit$x[, 2],
  JobSat_3 = factor(pca_df$JobSat_3, levels = c("Positive", "Neutral", "Negative"))
)

if (median(pca_plot_df$PC1[pca_plot_df$JobSat_3 == "Positive"], na.rm = TRUE) <
    median(pca_plot_df$PC1[pca_plot_df$JobSat_3 == "Negative"], na.rm = TRUE)) {
  pca_plot_df$PC1 <- -pca_plot_df$PC1
}

class_counts <- pca_plot_df %>%
  count(JobSat_3) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(JobSat_3, " (n=", n, ")"))

legend_labels <- setNames(class_counts$label, class_counts$JobSat_3)

p_pca <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = pca_plot_df %>% filter(JobSat_3 == "Positive"),
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = JobSat_3),
    alpha = 0.18,
    size = 0.56
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = pca_plot_df %>% filter(JobSat_3 == "Neutral"),
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = JobSat_3),
    alpha = 0.34,
    size = 0.64
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = pca_plot_df %>% filter(JobSat_3 == "Negative"),
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = JobSat_3),
    alpha = 0.11,
    size = 0.46
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Positive" = "#8FBCEB",
      "Neutral" = "#E9B45B",
      "Negative" = "#EB6A6A"
    ),
    breaks = c("Positive", "Neutral", "Negative"),
    labels = legend_labels
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(alpha = c(0.55, 0.80, 0.45), size = c(2.4, 2.6, 2.3)),
      nrow = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA shows strong class overlap",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9.2) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.8, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 1)),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6.8),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 4, 1, 4)
  )

left_panel <- p_remote / p_corr + plot_layout(heights = c(0.95, 1.05))
right_panel <- p_pca

(left_panel | right_panel) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.85, 1.35)) +
  plot_annotation(
    subtitle = "Some features show patterns, but the classes are still hard to separate.",
    caption = "Meaning: Negative and Neutral cases overlap with Positive cases. This makes prediction difficult, so Macro F1 is better than accuracy.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11.5, color = "grey25", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9.6, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 7))
    )
  )
```
